function.description: This API allows users to retrieve a specific Clean Air configuration feature template by ID.
function.name: api_getCleanAirConfigurationFeatureTemplate

id.description: Clean Air Configuration Feature Template Id

designName.description: The feature template design name. `Note:` The following characters are not allowed % & < > [ ] ' /

bleBeacon.description: BLE Beacon is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ.

bluetoothPagingInquiry.description: Bluetooth Paging Inquiry is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ.

bluetoothScoAcl.description: Bluetooth SCO ACL is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ.

continuousTransmitter.description: Continuous Transmitter is applicable for Radio Bands 2_4GHZ, 5GHZ, 6GHZ.

genericDect.description: Generic DECT is only applicable for Radio Bands 2_4GHZ, 5GHZ.

genericTdd.description: Generic TDD is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ, 5GHZ.

jammer.description: Jammer is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ, 5GHZ.

microwaveOven.description: Microwave Oven is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ.

motorolaCanopy.description: Motorola Canopy is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ, 5GHZ.

siFhss.description: SI FHSS is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ, 5GHZ.

spectrum80211Fh.description: Spectrum 802.11 FH is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ.

spectrum80211NonStandardChannel.description: Spectrum 802.11 Non STD Channel is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ and 5GHZ.

spectrum802154.description: Spectrum 802.15.4 is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ.

spectrumInverted.description: Spectrum Inverted is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ and 5GHZ.

superAg.description: Super AG is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ and 5GHZ.

videoCamera.description: Video Camera is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ and 5GHZ.

wimaxFixed.description: WiMAX Fixed is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ and 5GHZ.

wimaxMobile.description: WiMAX Mobile is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ and 5GHZ.

xbox.description: Xbox is only applicable for Radio Band 2_4GHZ.

id.description: id of the Clean Air configuration feature template

unlockedAttributes.description: attributes unlocked in design can be changed at device provision time. `Note:` unlockedAttributes can only contain the attributes defined under featureAttributes.
